datasets: NON FICTION ENGLISH ARTICLES FROM REPUTABLE SOURCES
Non-fiction English articles from reputable sources

changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to standard format, simplified dataset description, and added human-written outputs which are also evaluated

Removed TPR/FPR as they are evaluation metrics for detection performance, not automatic metrics for evaluating NLG outputs. This paper focuses on human detection of AI-generated text, not automatic evaluation of generation quality.
Consolidated model versions to base forms, simplified method names, and removed redundant/complex method descriptions while keeping core evaluation approaches

guideline: annotators were required to read the project guidelines and sign a consent form prior to the task

changes_made.explanation: Removed administrative details from guidelines and kept the actual evaluation criteria. The criteria list was already comprehensive and accurate.

overall_notes: The paper primarily studies human detection of AI-generated text rather than traditional NLG evaluation. While it does involve generation (creating AI-written articles), the main contribution is evaluating human detection capabilities. The LLM-as-judge usage is for detection classification rather than quality assessment of generated text.
